description: Type icons for Java, C#, PHP and Swift files - marks every source file in the Explorer with a class, interface, enum, struct, record, protocol or trait badge.
config.java.class: Badge shown on Java `class` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.java.interface: Badge shown on Java `interface` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.java.enum: Badge shown on Java `enum` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.java.record: Badge shown on Java `record` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.java.annotation: Badge shown on Java `@interface` (annotation) files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.php.class: Badge shown on PHP `class` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.php.interface: Badge shown on PHP `interface` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.php.enum: Badge shown on PHP `enum` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.php.trait: Badge shown on PHP `trait` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.csharp.class: Badge shown on C# `class` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.csharp.interface: Badge shown on C# `interface` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.csharp.struct: Badge shown on C# `struct` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.csharp.enum: Badge shown on C# `enum` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.csharp.record: Badge shown on C# `record` files. Both `record class` and `record struct` use this badge. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.swift.class: Badge shown on Swift `class` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.swift.struct: Badge shown on Swift `struct` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.swift.protocol: Badge shown on Swift `protocol` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.swift.enum: Badge shown on Swift `enum` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
config.swift.actor: Badge shown on Swift `actor` files. VS Code renders **at most 2 characters**. Leave empty to show no badge.
